capabilities: Toggle CSS snippets on and off from a status bar menu
Reload the snippets folder to pick up new or deleted snippets
Open a snippet in the default application for CSS files
Create new CSS snippets from a configurable template
Switch the menu between a default and a glass visual style
extras: The README references a demo section whose content is not present in the text.
intentEvidence: Think of it as a condensed and tucked away version of the "CSS Snippets" section in the settings tab.
motivation: The author was frustrated by constantly going back and forth between the workspace and the settings tab to test snippets and wanted them accessible directly in the workspace.
problem: Toggling CSS snippets on and off requires repeatedly navigating to Settings > Appearance > CSS snippets, which is slow and disruptive while working.
summary: Status bar menu that lets users quickly toggle, create, and open CSS snippets without opening the settings tab.
